newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse closes lower in dull trading.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse closes lower in dull trading.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index closed 0.31 percent lower on Monday in lacklustre trading, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 604.33 from 606.19 on Friday.
Trade volume was 633,646 dinars against 962,735 dinars, and was mostly in over-the-counter exchanges.
Coke bottler SFBT, back on the market after a three-week absence, was down 3.45 dinar to 111.690 dinars.
